event_name: Williams Martini Racing Document 27 Date 10 June 2018 Time 14:52 2018 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 7 - 10 June 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 18 collided with Car 28 between turns 5 & 6.
offence: Involved in an alleged incident as defined by Art 38.1 as defined by the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence that showed car No. 18 lost the rear in turn 5, as both cars were in close proximity they collided, no driver was predominantely to blame for the incident. Gerd Ennser Jose Abed Emanuele Pirro Paul Cooke
title: 2018 Canadian Grand Prix Decision Car 18 Turn 5 6 Incident27
